title: A small example reveals important meaning
meaning: Your shared view can acquire important new meaning when a small example reveals a possibility you want to investigate together.
text: An important realisation sometimes begins with a very small example. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating possibilities and observing which thought appears within them. The Star in energy supports an inspiring inquiry, hope for an honest direction in your shared view. Judgement in emotions responds with an awakening of understanding: a meaning that previously escaped attention becomes tangible. You may want to describe a familiar intention differently because a concrete trial has revealed something that matters within it.

Suppose you are preparing a trial selection of sounds for a small project. Among different recordings, ordinary sounds from a familiar courtyard particularly attract you. **A living example can reveal what your intention is really about.** You realise that the place’s memory interests you, while unusual recording was simply your first description. The discovery resonates more strongly than a successful technical solution. You can now discuss material through its connection with the theme and see why it matters to both of you, leaving room for different personal associations.

The vulnerable point is immediately giving the discovery such importance that every following version must confirm it. Wanting to preserve a significant meaning is understandable, yet new material may bring another shade to it. Your inspiring inquiry stays alive when refinement remains possible after a powerful realisation. The theme can become more precise while preserving what first made you want to continue the work.
